descriptions.value: The Menu Cart for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 3.2.1 does not sanitise and escape cart item variation data before outputting it in its cart slide-out, allowing unauthenticated users to store a Cross-Site Scripting payload that can be delivered to and executed in the session of another user, including a logged-in administrator.

assertions.title: WooCommerce Menu Cart < 3.2.1 - Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Cart Item Variation Attribute

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: WooCommerce Menu Cart < 3.2.1 - Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Cart Item Variation Attribute

descriptions.value: Jenkins 2.587 and earlier, LTS 2.580.1 and earlier does not apply its deserialization filter to classes referenced by the `resolves-to` attribute during XStream deserialization.

Jenkins 2.587 and earlier, LTS 2.580.1 and earlier converts the launch commands in older agent configurations into launchers provided by the Command Agent Launcher Plugin without checking whether they have been approved by an administrator, allowing attackers with Agent/Configure permission to execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.
Origin validation error in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in Visual Studio Code allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

descriptions.description: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

assertions.title: Visual Studio Code Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
